thread:
maya (Design): Quick design review — the new smoothing default is hiding short but critical spikes. users expect a clear signal for incidents, not just a prettier line.

sam (PM): Agree. Can we offer an 'edge-preserving' interpolate mode that smooths noise but preserves local maxima? Could be opt-in per-chart. :thinking_face:

ashley (Viz Eng): I prototyped `smooth_preserve_spikes` — it does a median filter but keeps points > 3σ. Quick config snippet:
```
mode: smooth_preserve_spikes
threshold_zscore: 3.0
preserve_peak_marker: true
```
On my test traces it keeps the short spikes while reducing jitter.

luis (Accessibility): @ashley nice. Accessibility notes: the preserved spike markers need keyboard focus and an `aria-label` describing value and timestamp. Also contrast: the default orange spike marker fails WCAG on dark theme.

maya (Design): For copy, prefer short toggle label: `Preserve spikes` (under smoothing controls). In the legend microcopy, group smoothing toggles under a chevron so it doesn't clutter series names.

sam (PM): Also consider unit-aware thresholds — percent vs absolute numbers change what a 3σ spike means. The threshold should adapt or be expressed as relative. We might show a tiny badge in the legend: `peak` when a recent spike is preserved.

ashley (Viz Eng): Implementation note: current continuous legend layout gets crowded. Proposal: condense per-series legend into two lines: first line = series name, second line = micro-legend like `smooth=on · preserve=3σ · unit=ms`. That keeps things compact without adding a modal.

maya (Design): Accessibility nit: don't rely on the micro-legend badges alone. Use `aria-describedby` on the series toggle so screen readers read smoothing state and threshold.

design-bot: New mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/mockups/edgespike_v3.png

sam (PM): :thumbsup: Let's A/B test current smoothing vs `smooth_preserve_spikes` for two weeks on staging traffic and check incident detection recall.

luis (Accessibility): Also add a keyboard shortcut to toggle smoothing for focused charts (`S`), with visible focus ring and tooltip explaining the shortcut.

maya (Design): I'll update the component spec and copy. Filing a follow-up PR with QA checklist: what to test (keyboard nav, color contrast, legend truncation, unit-adaptive thresholds).
